steps.q: A market has ten firms. If you wanted one number to show how much of the market the biggest few firms control, would you add up the share of just one firm, or of the leading few together?
steps.right: Add up the leading few firms' shares
steps.wrong: Look at just the single biggest firm's share

steps.q: Petrol stations, supermarkets and mobile networks are all industries where the top few firms hold the large majority of sales. Is this typical of an industry with many small, equal-sized rivals, or of one dominated by a few large firms?
steps.right: One dominated by a few large firms
steps.wrong: One with many small, equal-sized rivals

steps.right: Yes, they will feel it and react
